title: Vimarsha: Faithful ASR Evaluation for Indian Languages with Demographic Diversity, In-the-Wild Audio and Spelling Variations

bias_targets.methodology: Using a lattice of variations and Orthographically-Informed Word Error Rate (OIWER) to measure and mitigate pessimistic evaluation bias that unfairly penalizes valid spelling variations, loanwords, code-mixing, and morphological differences in Indian languages.
Comparing ASR model Word Error Rates (WER) on clean, controlled on-field recordings versus challenging, in-the-wild audio to evaluate optimistic performance biases present in standard benchmarks.
Analyzing ASR performance (WER) disparities across multiple speaker demographic dimensions, specifically age groups, gender, and educational qualification levels.
Evaluating and comparing district-level Word Error Rate (WER) across different regions in India to identify geographic and dialectal performance disparities.
